theme_strategy.vibe: Authority, clarity, truth. A digital 'Control Room' for study notes. Stripped of all fluff.
theme_strategy.rationale: For an educational study tool, users need focus. The Swiss Brutalist aesthetic provides stark clarity and structural hierarchy. Content is the sole focus.

typography.rules: Radical weight contrast (Black vs Light). Do not use Inter for headings. Use tight tracking for headings.

headings.usage: H1 (max text-6xl), H2, H3. Apply tracking-tight.

body.usage: All paragraph and standard UI text.

mono.usage: Overlines, labels, formulas, and metadata (date, chapter number). Use uppercase + wide tracking (tracking-widest).

colors.rules: Monochrome UI. Color exists only to guide action. Never use pure #000000, tint neutrals. Buttons should use primary color.

layout_and_spacing.rules: Dense, data correlation. Strict 1px borders. Use generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) for containers. Optical alignment over geometric.
layout_and_spacing.surface_styles: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout, items use border-r border-b. 0px or max 4px border radius.

component_guidelines.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (Crystal variant). backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark) with 1px delicate bottom border. Must contain Logo, navigation links, and a tactile Theme Switcher.
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Solid brand color for primary, transparent with 1px border for secondary. explicit hover states.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn based. Heavily customized to remove Vercel-look. Square edges, high contrast borders.
component_guidelines.notes_display: Bento Grid layout for notes: The Hero (Key Concepts, col-span-8), The Square (Formulas, col-span-4), The Tall (Quick Revision, col-span-4 row-span-2). Use Markdown rendering for the note content.
component_guidelines.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-lg), border color darkens.
component_guidelines.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a dense, highly legible dashboard look.

animations.rules: Minimalist. Hover states, focus states, subtle entrance staggered transitions. Use framer-motion.

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='subject-input', data-testid='generate-btn', data-testid='theme-toggle').

media.rules: No generic placeholder images. Use provided assets.

image_urls.description: Minimalist Swiss poster style abstract geometric composition. Use this in the main notes display area when no notes are generated yet.
Crisp architectural grid lines on warm off-white paper texture. Use as a subtle background pattern for the hero section or header if needed.
Minimalist workspace with an open notebook. Use for the 'Saved Notes' empty state or a landing/welcome page visual.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup Tailwind and Shadcn.
Apply fonts via Google Fonts in index.css (Chivo, DM Sans, JetBrains Mono).
Setup next-themes for Light/Dark mode toggling.
Implement the 'Control Room' bento grid layout for the note display.
Ensure all buttons/inputs have hover and focus states defined.
Use standard Markdown components to render the AI output.
Add 'data-testid' to every form input, button, and navigation item.
